description:
On the planet Tebé, he was hailed as the Lord of Death and the Living Apocalypse, the strongest necromancer of all. 

After obtaining Serezia’s help, he finally manages to return to Earth by his own power—but as a side effect, he loses all his abilities, ends up in the frail body of a young girl, and even develops severe social anxiety. One day, he comes across Song Ha‑yeon, a newbie necromancer who does livestreams online. In exchange for giving her advice, he receives magic stones filled with “fraudulent” energy and discovers that, by gathering this kind of energy from elsewhere, he can still use necromancy. 

Before long, he gets tangled up with Helena, an S‑rank hunter and necromancer, and learns the truth: his power is not gone, only sealed by some unknown force. When a status window suddenly appears before him, he realizes that if he levels up as a hunter, he can reclaim his strength. So he decides to become a hunter. 

“The lord of the underworld who even conquered death has finally returned to Earth— but thanks to a botched dimensional transfer, he’s now a total shut‑in loser.”
